mapper.select: SELECT q.module_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.status = 3) AS mastered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.priority = 'P0' AND sp.status = 3) AS p0_mastered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.status IS NOT NULL AND sp.status > 0) AS learned, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.next_review_at IS NOT NULL AND sp.next_review_at <= #{endOfToday}) AS due, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.status = 1) AS mistakes FROM study_progress sp INNER JOIN kb_question q ON q.id = sp.question_id AND q.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.module_id

SELECT sp.question_id FROM study_progress sp INNER JOIN kb_question q ON q.id = sp.question_id AND q.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.next_review_at IS NOT NULL AND sp.next_review_at <= #{endOfToday} ORDER BY sp.next_review_at ASC, sp.question_id ASC

SELECT q.id FROM kb_question q INNER JOIN kb_module m ON m.id = q.module_id LEFT JOIN study_progress sp ON sp.question_id = q.id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE q.is_deleted = FALSE AND (sp.id IS NULL OR sp.status = 0) ORDER BY CASE q.priority WHEN 'P0' THEN 0 WHEN 'P1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, m.sort_order ASC, q.sort_order ASC, q.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.id FROM kb_question q INNER JOIN kb_module m ON m.id = q.module_id LEFT JOIN study_progress sp ON sp.question_id = q.id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE q.is_deleted = FALSE AND q.priority = 'P0' AND (sp.id IS NULL OR sp.status <> 3) ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, q.sort_order ASC, q.id ASC

SELECT sp.question_id FROM study_progress sp INNER JOIN kb_question q ON q.id = sp.question_id AND q.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.status = 1 ORDER BY sp.lapse_count DESC, sp.last_reviewed_at ASC

SELECT sp.question_id FROM study_progress sp INNER JOIN kb_question q ON q.id = sp.question_id AND q.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN kb_module m ON m.id = q.module_id WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.is_starred = TRUE ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, q.sort_order ASC, q.id ASC
